note: **Stowe House, schedule 225 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Unfiled: the record holds no house of that name, and the walk puts it beside Felixstowe and Holly Lodge on Clumber Road West. Joan M Ball, 18, is a V.A.D. at a general hospital, the first in the record. A sixth line is a closed record.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
